parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
    external_id text, title text, company text, location text, work_mode text,
    url text, description text, posted_at timestamptz, publisher text,
    salary_min numeric, salary_max numeric, salary_currency text, salary_period text
  )
)
INSERT INTO jobs (
  job_hash, source, external_id, title, company, location, work_mode, url,
  description, posted_at, publisher, salary_min, salary_max, salary_currency, salary_period
)
SELECT
  md5(lower(trim(company)) || '|' || lower(trim(title)) || '|' || lower(coalesce(trim(location), ''))),
  'jsearch', external_id, title, company, location, work_mode, url,
  description, posted_at, publisher, salary_min, salary_max, salary_currency, salary_period
FROM incoming
ON CONFLICT (job_hash) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, title, company, publisher;
